title: fleet_burn: no semantic validation of baseline values (negative usage, future ts)
description: 3x codereview of lh2z fix (security finding 2, P3): scripts/fleet_burn.py:30 accepts any ints — negative usage -> huge burn -> false waste alarm + spurious P1 bd create; future ts -> negative age treated as mid-window FOREVER (alarm silently disabled until that timestamp arrives; reachable without an attacker via backward NTP/manual clock step). Fix: _load_baseline rejects usage<0 or ts<0 as corrupt; update() treats age<0 as corrupt baseline (re-establish) instead of mid-window skip.
